segments.name: Hotel Operations
segments.description: Owns and operates a full-service Hilton-branded hotel in San Francisco serving business, convention, group and leisure travelers.
segments.evidence: The Hotel generates revenues principally from guestrooms, food and beverage operations, parking and other ancillary operations and serves business, convention, group and leisure travelers.

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.description: Owns, manages and, when appropriate, sells multifamily and commercial real estate concentrated in Texas and Los Angeles County, California.
segments.evidence: In addition to the operations of the Hotel, the Company also generates income from the ownership, management and, when appropriate, sale of real estate.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue from hotel guests for rooms, food and beverage, and parking, and from tenants renting its multifamily and commercial properties.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company leases units in its residential rental properties on a short-term basis, with no lease extending beyond one year.
